lines.zh: 我浮着，脚下的土变成玻璃。
lines.en: I hover, and the soil below turns to glass.

lines.zh: 我慢慢移过山谷，星尘落下。
lines.en: I drift over the valley, shedding stardust.

lines.zh: 我的形体在光里破碎又聚合。
lines.en: My form breaks apart and gathers again.

lines.zh: 我每移动一寸，空气就发亮。
lines.en: Each inch I move makes the air glow.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，夜变短了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the night grows shorter.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条长长的光尾。
lines.en: I trail a long tail of light.
I pass the peaks and their tips frost over.
I slide down from the clouds, slowly.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上并不规则。
lines.en: My shadow on the ground is shapeless.
When I pass, the birds go silent.

lines.zh: 我悬着，身上的光时明时暗。
lines.en: I hang there, my light waxing and waning.

lines.zh: 我在数这颗星球的心跳。
lines.en: I'm counting this world's heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我的碎片在身边慢慢转。
lines.en: Fragments orbit slowly around me.
I fell here long ago.
I'm reading the position of the stars.

lines.zh: 我发出一种很低的鸣响。
lines.en: I emit a very low tone.

lines.zh: 草在我脚下往一个方向倒。
lines.en: The grass leans one way beneath me.
I gather my form slowly.

lines.zh: 我记得自己曾经在天上。
lines.en: I remember being in the sky.

lines.zh: 光从我的裂缝里漏出来。
lines.en: Light leaks through my cracks.

lines.zh: 我在等有人念出我的名字。
lines.en: I wait for someone to speak my name.
This land cannot bear me.

lines.zh: 我把一部分光收进体内。
lines.en: I draw some of my light inward.

lines.zh: 星辰的碎片在地上滚动。
lines.en: Shards of star-stuff roll on the ground.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，也不需要睡。
lines.en: I need neither breath nor sleep.

lines.zh: 我在想，我为什么会掉下来。
lines.en: I wonder why I fell.
You stand in my light, small.
I lower my vast head to you.
There's faint stardust on you.
You're not here for the shards, are you?
I know the light in your eyes.
Don't touch my cracks.

lines.zh: 我落下时，砸出了这片谷。
lines.en: This valley is the scar of my fall.
What do you see, looking up?

lines.zh: 我说话的时候，天上会响。
lines.en: When I speak, the sky answers.
You have a little time to leave.
I reach out a shape.

lines.zh: 你的重量对我来说很轻。
lines.en: Your weight is nothing to me.
One piece of me has broken off.

lines.zh: 星屑从我肩上散了几粒。
lines.en: A few motes of stardust scatter from my shoulder.
The sky rings again.
I slowly gather myself again.
That shifted me half a degree.
The fissure in the ground widens.
My form is unsteady.
You can move me. Remarkable.
I withdraw my outer light.
I can still stand. Don't gloat.
That star shard. You picked it up.
The light in your hand answers mine.
I lean toward you slowly.
I know this starfield.
You've raised the shard.
That broke off me when I fell.
I reach with a thread of light.

lines.zh: 星屑的光，绕着我的指节。
lines.en: Starlight curls around my knuckles.

lines.zh: 你的声音里有星的味道。
lines.en: Your voice tastes of stars.
I stop and let you decide.
You touch me and your fingers burn.

lines.zh: 我的形体重叠了你的影子。
lines.en: My form overlaps your shadow.
I draw back a spread of light.
Don't push; I weigh like a mountain.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，天上响了一声。
lines.en: We collide and the sky rings.

lines.zh: 你脚边的石头被光掀开。
lines.en: Stones at your feet lift in the light.

lines.zh: 我让开，地上的草烧了一片。
lines.en: I move aside and a patch of grass burns.
My light pushes you back two steps.

lines.zh: 你贴着我的边缘，很危险。
lines.en: You're at my edge. Dangerous.
I draw my light in so I don't burn you.

lines.zh: 另一颗星从天上落下来。
lines.en: Another star falls from the sky.
Our lights join into one.
It has shed fewer pieces than I.
We orbit slowly in the air.

lines.zh: 它的碎片绕着我的碎片。
lines.en: Its fragments circle mine.

lines.zh: 地上的草全部朝向我们。
lines.en: All the grass turns toward us.
We don't speak; the light does.

lines.zh: 两个落下的星，站在一起。
lines.en: Two fallen stars, standing together.
Together we light the night.

lines.zh: 这片天空，本来是我们的。
lines.en: This sky was ours to begin with.
I draw the shard into myself.
That's a piece of me. I remember.

lines.zh: 我掌心的光把它吸住不放。
lines.en: The light in my palm catches it and will not let go.
It circles slowly near me.
I tuck the shard into a crack.
That light does me little good.

lines.zh: 我掀起一阵光，把它推回土里。
lines.en: I raise a gust of light and push it back into the soil.

lines.zh: 地上的碎片自己浮了起来。
lines.en: The shards on the ground rise on their own.

lines.zh: 它太轻，我几乎感觉不到。
lines.en: It's so light I barely feel it.
This one. Keep it.
You've moved my shards.
My light is turning red.

lines.zh: 我的形体在光里舒展开。
lines.en: My form unfurls in the light.
This valley is my grave.
Don't stand directly beneath me.
The sky begins to press down.

lines.zh: 我不是来打架的，可我会。
lines.en: I didn't come to fight, but I will.

lines.zh: 我的重量已经压弯了坡。
lines.en: My weight has bent the slope.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在光里很清楚。
lines.en: Your breath is plain in my light.
I've marked your position among the stars.
This time I don't rein it in.
You can still take one step back. Now.

lines.zh: 我把所有的碎片收回来。
lines.en: I call all my fragments back.

lines.zh: 天上有一道光正在落下。
lines.en: A beam of light is falling.
I raise a hand slowly.
You stand in my wound.

lines.zh: 我从坠落那天就在等你。
lines.en: I've waited since the day I fell.

lines.zh: 我的碎片围着你转成圈。
lines.en: My shards circle you in a ring.
My light follows you.
Wherever you retreat, I see you.
My fragments orbit around you.
The shadow on the ground grows brighter.
I'm measuring the sky above you.
You have no cover.
I gather my light in bit by bit.
The grass burns where you run.
I descend slowly.
This blow will come from above.

lines.zh: 你听见天上的鸣响了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the ringing in the sky?
I've waited long for this.
The farther you retreat, the brighter I burn.
The air begins to charge.
I tilt my body toward you.

lines.zh: 光从天顶垂下来，罩住谷地。
lines.en: Light pours from the zenith and covers the valley.

lines.zh: 我落下的风压弯了野草。
lines.en: The wind of my descent bends the wild grass.
I've measured every step you take.
You won't get a second chance.
I raise my hand as high as it goes.

lines.zh: 一束光落下来，地面熔了。
lines.en: A beam falls and the ground melts.
My edge sweeps past you.
The impact lifts you off your feet.

lines.zh: 你没有挡住，也不需要挡。
lines.en: You didn't block, and couldn't have.
Light bursts around you.
Your armor glows red hot.
This strike needs no hand, only light.
You're thrown into the rubble.

lines.zh: 我在你身后又落下一束。
lines.en: Another beam falls behind you.

lines.zh: 我的身体是烧红的星核。
lines.en: My body is a star core burned red.
I draw some light back.
Your breathing is shaking.

lines.zh: 这一片地面已经很薄了。
lines.en: The ground here has grown thin.
This is the last.
A seam of light opens in the sky.

lines.zh: 我落下来的时候，山谷成型了。
lines.en: When I landed, the valley was made.

lines.zh: 整片夜空突然亮了一瞬。
lines.en: The whole night sky flares for an instant.

lines.zh: 地上多了一个巨大的影子。
lines.en: A vast shadow appears on the ground.

lines.zh: 星屑先落，我的形体后到。
lines.en: Stardust lands first; my form follows.
I rise slowly from below the ground.

lines.zh: 有人在夜里念了我的名字。
lines.en: Someone spoke my name in the night.
Stones roll toward me.
My light arrives first; the form follows.

lines.zh: 这片天没有星星，只有我。
lines.en: This sky has no stars but me.

lines.zh: 我把一条光尾收进体内。
lines.en: I draw a tail of light into myself.
Every bird in the valley has fled.

lines.zh: 我的碎片从四面八方汇来。
lines.en: My fragments converge from every side.

lines.zh: 地面被我压出一个浅坑。
lines.en: I press a shallow crater into the ground.
I open my eyes. The light is white.
I fell here. Then I woke.
The night here is too short.

lines.zh: 我悬在山谷上方，慢慢亮起。
lines.en: I hover above the valley and slowly kindle.

lines.zh: 我一只手按地，震起一圈尘。
lines.en: I plant one hand on the ground and raise a ring of dust.
Stardust falls across the whole field.
To a star, fire is only warmth.

lines.zh: 我又从高处落了一次，与上次一样。
lines.en: I fall from a height again, just as before.

lines.zh: 水浇上来，我的光暗了一下。
lines.en: Water strikes and my light dims.

lines.zh: 爆风把我散开的部位吹得更远。
lines.en: The blast scatters my loose parts farther.

lines.zh: 我这颗星，砸下来就没回去。
lines.en: This star of mine fell and never rose.

lines.zh: 这法术和我的光撞在一起，很响。
lines.en: That spell clashes with my light. Loudly.

lines.zh: 我很久没有光了，快要熄。
lines.en: I've gone long without light. I'm fading.

lines.zh: 雷与我共鸣，我的光更盛了。
lines.en: Lightning resonates with me, and my light grows.

lines.zh: 虚空在拉我，像要把我送回天上。
lines.en: The void pulls me, as if to send me home.
